state.product: Zenno — the universal booking layer that makes local appointment businesses (salons, barbers, beauty, wellness, clinics) bookable by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Siri, Gemini and Perplexity.
state.founder_goal: Sell and launch as fast as possible. Stop stalling on decisions. Hamburg is the first city.

current_state.backend: Agent API live on Supabase: search, manifest, availability, hold, book, cancel, reschedule, plus agent-admin. TypeSafe Jev gates book/cancel/reschedule on confidence.
current_state.auth_model_today: Each merchant generates its own za_ API key in the dashboard and must hand it to an agent.
current_state.merchant_dashboard_today: AI Agents page shows jargon: API key, hold TTL seconds, lead time minutes, vertical, consent policy.
current_state.frontend: The AI Agents page exists only locally; the live Vercel site has not been redeployed.
current_state.distribution: No AI assistant knows Zenno exists yet. Nothing is listed in any assistant's tool or app directory.
current_state.notifications: No notification is sent to a merchant when an agent books or when a booking awaits approval.

users.merchants: Small, often older, non-technical salon and clinic owners in Hamburg. Busy with clients, check their phone between appointments, uncomfortable with technical terms.
users.end_customers: People of all ages, including older people, who ask an AI assistant in plain language to book an appointment.

state.constraints: Tiny team. Anything that needs a partnership approval from OpenAI, Google or Apple takes weeks and is not under our control. Existing stack: React/Vite on Vercel, Supabase Postgres and Edge Functions, Resend-style email already used for booking confirmations.

key_model.instructions: Which API key model should Zenno launch with, given the users and the goal in `state`?

criteria.platform_keys: One key per AI platform (e.g. one for OpenAI, one for Perplexity) issued and managed by Zenno in super-admin; merchants never see keys and only flip a switch to be bookable.
criteria.merchant_keys: Keep today's model: every merchant generates and hands out its own key.
criteria.platform_keys_plus_advanced_merchant_key: Platform keys by default, while merchants can still optionally create their own key from a hidden advanced section for custom integrations.

merchant_ui.instructions: How should the merchant AI Agents page be designed for the merchants described in `state.users.merchants`?

criteria.one_switch_two_choices: One large switch 'Let AI assistants book appointments', two plain choices 'Approve each booking myself' or 'Accept automatically', sensible defaults prefilled, all technical settings hidden under a collapsed 'Advanced' section.
criteria.keep_detailed: Keep all current technical settings visible on the main page.
criteria.guided_wizard: A multi-step setup wizard that walks the merchant through every setting before enabling.

default_consent.instructions: Which confirmation policy should be the default for a merchant who just turned AI booking on?

criteria.manual: Agent bookings wait as pending until the merchant approves each one.
criteria.auto: Agent bookings are confirmed immediately if the slot is free, exactly like the existing online booking form; the merchant can switch to manual approval any time.

merchant_notification.instructions: What should notify a merchant about new or pending agent bookings at launch, given the stack and users in `state`?

criteria.email_only: An email to the business address for every agent booking, with a one-tap approve link when approval is needed.
criteria.email_plus_dashboard_badge: The email above plus an unread badge and list in the admin dashboard.
criteria.sms_or_whatsapp: Build SMS or WhatsApp messaging first.

first_distribution_channel.instructions: Which distribution channel should be built first so real AI assistants can actually find and book Zenno businesses soonest, respecting the constraints in `state`?

criteria.mcp_server: A public MCP server over the existing agent API, usable immediately by Claude, ChatGPT developer mode, Cursor and other MCP clients without partner approval.
criteria.chatgpt_app_directory: Apply to the ChatGPT app directory first and wait for review.
criteria.google_reserve_partner: Apply to become a Reserve with Google booking partner first.
criteria.llms_txt_only: Only publish llms.txt and agent.json files and hope assistants crawl them.

e2e_test_key.instructions: How should the live end-to-end test of the agent API get its credential, given the founder does not want manual steps?

criteria.internal_test_key: Zenno seeds a dedicated internal test platform key and an internal test business, so the test runs without the founder doing anything.
criteria.merchant_generated_key: The founder logs in, generates a key and pastes it.

frontend_release.instructions: When should the frontend with the AI Agents page and the new landing page be released to the live Vercel site?

criteria.after_simplification: Release right after the simplified merchant page and platform keys are built in this same work session, so merchants never see the jargon version.
criteria.now: Release the current jargon version immediately.
criteria.later: Hold the release for a later date.
